feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 21 May 2026 10:38pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 21 May 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure area in the mid-Atlantic and high pressure area over continental Europe, with warm and moist southerly air stream in the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South or southeast 3 or 4, gradually veering south or southwest 4 or 5 through the night, but variable 3 or less in the east at times. Decreasing 3 or 4 early Friday night.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Areas of mist and isolated fog patches Friday morning and afternoon, especially in the west of the area.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor or very poor in mist and fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 in most waters Saturday evening, 3 in the far east of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first, becoming smooth in the far southeast of the area Saturday afternoon.


##Weather##

Light rain to start. Continuing risk of mist and fog patches Friday night through Saturday day.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor or very poor in mist and fog patches.
